verification.note: Reproduced. At the reviewed tree, addons/intelligence/app/digit_separator.py:5 is `_SEPARATORS = frozenset(".,:：")`, and it is used at lines 19, 37 and 45. The addon reflogs (main checkout .git/modules/addons/intelligence/logs/HEAD:690-698) show that feature/digit-colon-times branched from ba49803, then got commits 1611551 ('test: acceptance tests for SPEC-ADDON-015') and e102ecb ('fix: treat a colon between digits as part of the number'). Addon main then fast-forwarded ba49803 -> 1f33822. feature/whisper-local-model-display was created from 1f33822 and reached fe978f8 through the two SPEC-ADDON-016 commits. So the pointer range ba49803..fe978f8 carries the colon change. docs/specs/INDEX.md:33-34 goes from SPEC-ADDON-014 to SPEC-ADDON-016. Grep finds SPEC-ADDON-015 only in addons/intelligence/tests/test_digit_separator_breaks.py and test_subtitle_line_split_numbers.py, with no spec in docs/. The spec's touch points (docs/specs/whisper-local-model-display.md:85-) do not name it. One step is inferred: that 1f33822 contains e102ecb. It follows from the fe978f8 tree having the colon and from the only fe978f8-side commits being SPEC-ADDON-016 work; I could not walk the commit graph.

Reproduced. At the reviewed tree, addons/intelligence/search-config.yml.example:384-393 has no '# Default: openai/whisper-small' line. Sibling worktrees on other branches (video_share-epub-controls/addons/intelligence/search-config.yml.example:386, wt-review-intel/search-config.yml.example:386) still have '# Default: openai/whisper-small (244M, ~500MB int8 RAM)' at the same spot, so this branch's addon bump removed it. The spec says 'Docs: none' (whisper-local-model-display.md:99) and does not list the example config as a touch point. The removed comment was stale: app/config.py:34 sets the default to openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, matching the example's value at line 393. The edit is therefore correct in content but outside the declared touch points.
